test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows, five in each row, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent persons.

Row I contains A, B, C, D, and E, all of whom are facing south. Row II contains R, S, T, U and V, all of whom are facing north. Thus, each person faces a person from the other row. A sits at the right end of his row and faces U. R sits in the middle of his row and faces C. E sits between C and D, facing T. S sits at the right end of his row.

Who sits exactly opposite B?
solution:
Row I contains A, B, C, D, and E, all of whom are facing south. Row II contains R, S, T, U and V, all of whom are facing north. 

1. A sits at the right end of his row and faces U.

2. R sits in the middle of his row and faces C. 

3. E sits between C and D, facing T. 

4. S sits at the right end of his row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a6e604c569ebe4a35ea7f6ee108c3ceb2625c367fc8812219d51ceb4feaf0d5.png] 

V sits exactly opposite B.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
